financialSemantics: Estimated Opportunity Value is rep-entered commercial context and not CRM authority
Modeled Customer Investment is the customer cost used by ROI
Annual Customer Benefit is annual modeled economic value
Total Contract Benefit follows the configured contract term
Net Economic Benefit is contract benefit less modeled investment
Contract ROI, NPV and Payback require modeled investment
roiKnowledge: ROI Model v2.8 separates direct cost savings, recovered contribution margin, working-capital benefit, capacity value and risk avoidance
Direct lost-sales contribution margin takes precedence over modeled OTIF-gap contribution margin
Service penalties and expedite premium are separate economic drivers
Workforce productivity methods do not stack within their overlap pool
Carrying and turns estimates do not double count
Inventory accuracy calibrates recovery assumptions but does not create dollars alone
Field Inventory, first-time-fix truck rolls and field reconciliation remain separate
No governed default should be invented
valueHistory: Prospect draft is not submitted evidence
Prospect submitted is immutable submitted evidence
Customer provided and Customer revalidated are customer-supported states
Current, Aging and Stale describe evidence freshness
Historical scenarios preserve what was used at that time; Value History preserves what was learned across the opportunity
outputGovernance: Ready to Share, Review Before Sharing and Draft Only govern presentation readiness only
Output Readiness does not change BuyCycle Stage, ROI Maturity or Buyer Commitment
Customer Proof is approved peer evidence, not current-customer validation; omit it when no approved proof exists
competitiveGovernance: Competitive Company and Competitive Product are distinct
RFgen and RF-SMART are separate competitive products
A Research Run is not approved intelligence
Only governed source/finding approval can publish a Battlecard revision
Approved intelligence may be Current, Aging or Stale
solutionFitKnowledge: A missing Solution Fit is a not-created state, not a load error
Sales Engineers and Admins may create Solution Fits within authorized customer scope; Reps and Sales Managers are read-only unless another role grants edit capability
MEP scope is selected in Product, ERP, Applications order
The governed MEP ERP choices are JDE, EBS, Oracle Fusion, SAP ECC6 and SAP Hana
A Standard App means the application exists in the governed ERP catalog; it never implies Full Fit, demonstrated, or customer validated
Changing ERP changes active catalog scope while preserving exact-name assessments, custom applications and prior history
ERP version is optional and ERP is entered once in Solution Scope
Partial Fit and Gap applications can create a pre-populated gap record
Solution Fit readiness uses selected applications only and still requires Demo Status, Fit and Customer Validation
cleanup: Remove is recoverable; permanent delete is separately governed
Current-scenario protection, share-link inactivity, immutable submission preservation, Value History and audit history remain governed
